label: sealed and certified by
notes: The other half of him. A Warden-surveyor answers to two bodies with one seal, and the College's house rule - findings on the roll before the commissioner sees them - is the loyalty that beat the Wardenry by a few weeks. His whole character is that fracture: he wants the measurement on the record and cannot make himself be the man who put it there, because one of his two employers is destroyed by it.
